question_stem: Nuclei of an isotope of copper (Cu) each have 29 protons and 37 neutrons. This isotope is a $\beta^{-}$ emitter.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State the nuclide notation in the form $^{A}_{Z}X$ for this nucleus of copper.

parts.label: (b)
(b)(i)
parts.text: Use Fig. 7.1 to explain why other particles apart from the $\beta^{-}$ particles must be emitted during this decay.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State the name of the other particle emitted during the decay of this isotope.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
The copper isotope decays to an isotope of zinc (Zn).

Give the radioactive decay equation for this decay. Include the nucleon and proton numbers of all the particles involved.
